_comment: Centralized parameter location across entirety of model. Hardcoded fallbacks are in the individual modules.

assignment._comment: SA seams for the Script 1/4 flow model (road_revised.py). All default-neutral: capacity_scale/breakpoint_scale/congestion_scale multiply per-tier profile values (1.0 = historical), speed_shift_mph shifts free-flow speeds additively (0.0 = historical; floored at per-tier min speed), effective_hours_per_day is the daily capacity/flow divisor (24 = historical).
assignment._comment_t08b: use_table_t08b switches Script 1's road_links init from T08's flat per-tier dict to a real per-link join against T08b_facility_area_capacity_speed_US_candidate.csv (NCHRP 825 Exhibit 128) -- facility_type/area_type/lane_category derived per link from hpms_fclass/urban/lanes, see resiflow.networks.t08b_profile. Attaches flow_cap_plph/flow_breakpoint_plph/congestion_factor, which edge_init/edge_initial_speed_func/update_edge_speed already prefer over the tier dict when present. Downtown/Suburban area_type split and the 8%-small-metro-population adjustment are both deferred (collapsed to a single Urban row) -- no urbanized-area-size crosswalk exists in this project yet.

cost_time._comment: avg_vehicle_occupancy_car 1.52 is NHTS 2022 Table 5-2's average all-purpose vehicle occupancy (persons per vehicle trip), replacing the audit's provisional 1.67 all-purpose figure -- 1.67 was flagged by the audit itself as a known value-level issue pending a sourced replacement; 1.52 is that replacement, not the commute-only figure (~1.18). isolation_usd_per_day monetizes isolated trips in Script 4 (freight monetization is a flagged open research question; default mirrors Script 5's ISOLATION_UNIT_COST_USD).

cost_operating._comment_tables: use_table_* flags (default false = formula path). Wave-1 VOC sealed Li-like: time (A-3 VOT) + fuel-only (T04_avg_fuel_VOC) + toll; T05 non-fuel is OUT_OF_SCOPE (see T05_nonfuel_OUT_OF_SCOPE.csv). Keep use_table_nonfuel_curve=false; do not point at ATRI T05.

preprocess._comment_bridge_index: nbi_bridge_index_path: output of scripts/build_nbi_bridge_index.py. Locational flag only (road_bridge / bridge_fraction); costing uses structure_length_m + deck_width_m. Null/non-positive length or deck → match excluded. Prefer Desktop/.../enrichment/faf5_road_links_bridge_tunnel_patched.gpq as the working network until production is swapped. NTAD NBI via load_ntad_bridge_gdb.py.
preprocess._comment_nti_tunnel_index: nti_tunnel_index_path: e_id-keyed parquet from build_nti_tunnel_index.py. Locational flag (road_tunnel / tunnel_fraction); costing uses tunnel_length_m. Null/non-positive length → excluded. Prefer over HPMS STRUCTURE_TYPE.
preprocess._comment_hpms_lrs: hpms_lrs_enriched_csv is the CSV from scripts/hpms_to_faf_lrs_transfer.py. QA / terrain / toll-presence; STRUCTURE_TYPE=2 is only a tunnel fallback when nti_tunnel_index_path is unset.

hazard_disruption._comment: speed_depth_exponent is p in V = V_max*(1 - d/d_c)**p (fragility/flood_operational.py); p=2 reproduces the historical Pregnolato quadratic, p=1 the linear alternate. damage_state_operational_table = T36 HAZUS day-1 functionality factors for earthquake/landslide (forked bridge|road); replaces prior hardcoded 1/0.85/0.5/0/0 PLACEHOLDER.
hazard_disruption._comment_truck_threshold: flood_closure_threshold_truck_cm (T19's own header: cars xd=30, heavy trucks xd=60, Kramer et al. 2016) drives an ADDITIONAL max_speed_truck column (apply_max_speed_to_links) alongside the passenger-threshold max_speed above -- the shared assignment-stage speed/capacity solve still uses the car threshold unchanged; max_speed_truck is for freight-specific rerouting-cost reporting to consume (not yet wired into Script 4's freight cost stream -- see docs/FLOOD_TABLE_REVIEW.md).

vulnerability._comment: SA seams for Script 3 vulnerability curves. curve_theta (0..1, null = off) blends each low/high-flow damage-curve pair d=(1-theta)*d_low+theta*d_high; depth_scale_lambda (0.8..1.25, null = off) evaluates curves at depth/lambda (damage-onset shift); damage_threshold_scale multiplies every categorical depth threshold in fragility/flood_categorical.py (1.0 = historical).
vulnerability._comment_damage_ratio: use_table_damage_ratio_curves switches Script 3's C1-C6 depth-damage curves from damage_curves/damage_ratio_road_flood.xlsx (ungitted, local-only) to parameters/tables/T22_damage_ratio_curves_TEMPLATE.csv. Left FALSE: T22's manifest status is TEMPLATE_REPLACE_VALUES -- its numbers are illustrative shapes, not sourced (see the CSV's own header and van Ginkel et al. 2021 SI). Flip only after replacing T22's values with real extracted data; the wiring itself (unit conversion cm->m, column renaming) is tested and ready.
vulnerability._comment_earthquake_liquefaction: use_table_earthquake_liquefaction switches hazus_bridge.compute_row_direct_damage_musd()'s earthquake ROAD branch from a hardcoded $0 (HAZUS Table 7-5 has no ground-shaking roadway curve, and this project computes no liquefaction PGD for earthquake) to the real PGA->liquefaction->PGD->cost chain in T31 (parameters/tables/T31_earthquake_road_liquefaction_pga_lookup.csv), keyed by a real per-segment liquefaction susceptibility class -- see hazards/liquefaction.py and scripts/prepare_cusec_liquefaction_susceptibility.py. Coverage is real but regional (8 CUSEC states: AL/AR/IL/IN/KY/MO/MS/TN), so this only produces nonzero road cost for the New Madrid scenario (403); Mineral (401) and Cascadia (404) roads correctly stay $0 (no susceptibility data there, not an assumption).
vulnerability._comment_winter_storm_cost: use_table_winter_storm_cost switches scripts/3_damage_analysis.py's winter_storm branch from the flood-shim path (snow depth mm/1000 repackaged as a fake flood depth, confirmed 150-1000x off vs. real Jonas damage estimates) to T32's real DOT-regression direct cleanup cost formula (parameters/tables/T32_winter_storm_direct_cost_function.csv, hazards/winter_storm_cost.py). duration_hours/air_temp_F per event come from real companion rasters (scripts/prepare_winter_storm_duration_temp.py: SNODAS 3-day depth-delta proxy for duration -- NOT the ideal 6-hr NOHRSC snowfall analysis T32's own header cites, that historical archive wasn't readily reachable within scope -- and PRISM daily tmin for temperature) for all 4 real winter-storm events (Jonas/Uri/Elliott/Snowmageddon); missing on a given segment falls back to winter_storm_cost.py's own documented defaults, never a fabricated value.

damage_costs._comment: Unit-cost scales applied in Script 3 AFTER the pristine damage_cost workbook loads (the workbook is never edited). 1.0 = historical.

recovery._comment: Flood: residual_depth_gates_m (T27 recession). Earthquake/landslide: T37/T38 residual speed by damage×day (HAZUS Table 7-4); Script 4 branches on hazard_type — do not use flood_depth_max gates for EQ/LS. table_recovery_scenario also selects T26 capacity and T37/T38 speed scenarios.
